text:
Aisha: quick sync on Chrysalis VPC onboarding — couple of urgent items before cutover. KMS grants for our service principal expire in ~3 weeks, customer hasn't provided the principal ARN yet, and audit logs path needs to be validated (they want logs to Splunk over TLS). Renewal contact flagged a potential delay if we don't hit the audit log SLA. Can someone take KMS rotation ownership and confirm the principal?

Ben: I can take KMS rotation.
Need the principal ARN + whether they require key policy or IAM grant. Also what's the required rotation window?

Kara: saw one risky SG rule in their staging account — they opened healthcheck IPs to 0.0.0.0/0. We should propose least-priv rules. Suggested snippet for them to apply:
```
# allow healthchecks from our monitoring pool only
Resource: aws_security_group_rule
Ingress: tcp 443 from 10.240.32.0/20
Ingress: tcp 8080 from 10.240.32.0/20
```
Also we need the list of IPs we told them for egress (I'll confirm).

Diego: for audit logs: they want to forward to Splunk HC via TCP TLS on port 9997. We need NAT + route table in their private subnet to allow outbound to splunk-hosts. I'll spin up a quick test setup and share tcpdump. Runbook step I'll add:
```
# test forwarder (on their host)
echo test | openssl s_client -connect splunk.example.net:9997 -quiet
```
I'll also validate that our egress allowlist is correct.

Aisha: thanks. Action items and deadlines:
- Ben -> KMS policy draft + required principal by EOD Thu (Ben)
- Diego -> NAT + forwarder smoke test Fri 09:00 PT (Diego)
- Kara -> SG least-priv proposal + exact IP list by Thu noon (Kara)
I'll also mark renewal risk in Salesforce and loop AMs if we miss Thu. Ops: please ensure we don't escalate to legal yet — this is a product-readiness risk, not contract-level.

ops-bot: checklist updated: KMS_rotation_assignee=Ben; NAT_test_assignee=Diego; SG_review_assignee=Kara; next_checkin=7087658100 (Fri 09:30 PT).

Ben: putting a KMS policy draft here: https://git.redwood/cs/chrysalis/kms-draft — will update once I get ARN.

Aisha: :thumbsup: keeping this thread as the canonical place for audit notes. If anyone hits a blocker ping @Aisha and drop the PR/Runbook link here.

Diego: added tcpdump logs to the runbook PR: https://git.redwood/cs/chrysalis/runbooks/forwarder-test

Kara: sending the IP allowlist in DM to the customer so we don't paste internal ranges here. Will update thread when confirmed.

Aisha: great, talk Fri 09:30 PT — thanks everyone :heart:
